other_conditions: Team must be from an AICTE‑approved technical institution or Deemed to be University
Team must have undertaken a remarkable intervention in the last two years from the date of announcement
Maximum team size is 5 members with a minimum of 2 women members
Each institute may submit up to 5 applications for different themes
benefits_summary: Cash prize awards ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000 for the winning teams and runners‑up.
